comments.author: Sianyde
comments.body_html:
Yeah, normally you’d just use BSG’s existing properties of guns and not touch the magazine filter; keeping the properties of the parent gun. But I had to remove some of the larger magazines to prevent clipping and wanted to add the multicaliber capability.

To make this possible with BSG’s engine- the options were either create two entirely different guns (like the SCAR or MDR), or try to replicate the real-steel modularity of accepting other ammunition. The latter seemed cooler.

But give me some time to think on this. Today’s focus was on eliminating some bugs.
